retail_vs_institutional_reaction.retail_sentiment_summary: Retail and FinTwit semiconductor traders were stunned by the divergence between Lam Research's blowout fundamentals—$8.22B Q3 revenue (+54% YoY), 40.2% Non-GAAP operating margin, $3.50B operating cash flow, +27% dividend hike to $0.33/sh, and an $8.60B Q4 revenue guide—and the -7.41% after-hours selloff from $260.81 to $241.48. Traders pointed out that LRCX had already rallied +115% YoY into the print (trading at 45.3x trailing P/E) and that a higher Q3 tax rate ($559M vs $278M in Q2) capped headline Non-GAAP EPS at $2.20 vs $2.18 consensus.
retail_vs_institutional_reaction.institutional_sentiment_summary: Institutional semiconductor PMs universally characterized the print and $8.60B December-quarter guide as a massive operational beat (+35% QoQ Systems growth to $5.73B, Korea 20% / Taiwan 18% leading-edge inflection, $3.09B True FCF). Desks attributed the after-hours pullback to $241.48 (right back to T-1's $238.97 baseline before Wednesday's pre-close run-up) to crowded long positioning and profit-taking after the stock's parabolic run.
retail_vs_institutional_reaction.after_hours_movement_driver: Despite reporting record $8.22B revenue and guiding Q4 to $8.60B, LRCX pulled back -7.41% after hours to $241.48 from a lofty $260.81 close (45.28x trailing P/E) as fast-money longs locked in profits on the modest +$0.02 headline EPS beat ($2.20 vs $2.18, held back by a 16.9% tax rate vs 10.9% in Q2).
